annotations.title: Rank federal spending by state, agency, company or industry

description:
Which states, agencies, companies or industries got the most federal money, in one call:
    e.g. "which states got the most Department of Transportation grant money in FY2025", "top
    Army contractors in Texas", "biggest NAICS codes at VA". Obligations from USAspending.gov.
    For anything a ranking can't express, run_plan.

agency.description: Only this agency or bureau, e.g. "Department of Transportation", "Army".
agency.title: Agency

award_type.description: "contract" or "assistance" (grants, loans, direct payments); empty: all.
award_type.title: Award Type

fiscal_year.description: Federal fiscal year (Oct-Sep); default: the latest complete one.
fiscal_year.title: Fiscal Year

naics.description: Only this industry: a NAICS code or words, e.g. "541512" or "janitorial".
naics.title: Naics

program.description: Only this assistance program (CFDA/ALN number or name).
program.title: Program

rank_by.description: What to rank: state, county, city, agency, bureau, company, industry, product, program, district, office, vehicle or year.
rank_by.title: Rank By

state.description: Only work in this state, e.g. "Texas" or "TX".
state.title: State

name: spending_rankings
title: Rank federal spending by state, agency, company or industry
